submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best simulated resolution (2.95% at 5 cm, against 4.29% for K1 and about 8.5% for K2 in the 2025 summary). Resolution at 5 cm is better than at 3 cm (3.14%) or 8 cm (3.33%). Low-background suitability is not documented, so it is unverified. The documents contain no data on intrinsic radioactivity (for example 138La, 176Lu or Ac/Ra contamination) for any candidate. The lead and copper shielding does not remove activity inside the crystal. Before procurement, get radiopurity assay data from the vendor for K3. If K3 is too radioactive, fall back to K1.

requirements.evidence: K3 at 5 cm: 2.95% FWHM, the best of the three. K1 at 5 cm: 4.29%. K2 at 5 cm: 8.5% (2025 summary only, not re-simulated).

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: No document gives intrinsic radiopurity data for any crystal. The shielding (20 cm Pb + 5 cm Cu, radon purge) is installed but does not address internal activity. K3 needs a vendor radiopurity assay.
